errors.missing_auth_permissions: Missing permissions to change authentication requirements for the installation
errors.missing_installation_access: User does not have access to the installation
errors.failed_phase_switch_current_update: Failed to update 3 to 1-phase switch current
errors.failed_charging_mode_update: Failed to update installation charging mode
errors.authentication_failed: Zaptec rejected the login, repair the device to log in again
errors.missing_credentials: No Zaptec login is stored for this charger, repair the device to log in again
errors.resume_awaiting_authorization: the charger is waiting for authorization. Zaptec can only resume a paused session, a new session starts once the car is authorized
errors.resume_schedule_active: a Zaptec charging schedule is active, and Zaptec does not resume charging while it is
errors.resume_car_stopped: the car stopped charging by itself, for example because it is full
errors.resume_not_paused: Zaptec can only resume a session that was paused
